Consequently any sequence with full excess energy tending to zero has strong unweighted L2 potential-gradient/field-velocity and scale-gradient/velocity convergence; density and internal-energy density converge strongly L1, relative entropy to rho tends to zero, and matter kinetic flux vanishes. Full combined momentum/stress and total-energy DENSITIES converge strongly L1, excluding the FGF041 concentration in this zero-excess class. For already-existing trajectories, assumed energy inequality, H1 scale continuity and strongly prepared initial energy give a conditional uniform-in-time conclusion via the explicit scale barrier. General matter energy flux, separate force product, actual PDE existence and physical closure remain outside the result.
